title: Spore Cluster Colony
description: The tunnel opens into a chamber carpeted with bioluminescent spore clusters. Pulsing green and violet light radiates from the largest formations, casting eerie shadows. The spores drift lazily in the still air -- beautiful but potentially reactive. Disturbing them could release a concentrated burst.

choices.label: Careful extraction
choices.description: Gently harvest individual spore clusters with patience.

outcomes.text: Steady hands pay off. You twist each cluster free without bursting a single cap. Clean, valuable specimens.
The largest cluster comes free and reveals a glowing spore nestled beneath -- a rare find usually hidden deep in the colony.
Your knife slips and punctures a ripe cluster. A cloud of spores erupts into your face. You stagger back coughing, clutching what you managed to save.

choices.label: Disturb the colony
choices.description: Shake the clusters loose for a bigger haul. The spore burst will sting.

outcomes.text: You slam the colony wall and clusters rain down. The spore burst stings your lungs, but the haul is impressive.
The entire colony erupts in a chain reaction of bursting caps. Toxic spore fog fills the chamber. Everyone is choking.
Clusters scatter everywhere and you scramble to gather them. The burst is smaller than expected -- mostly harmless pollen.

choices.label: Admire and move on
choices.description: The bioluminescence is mesmerizing. You leave it undisturbed.

outcomes.text: The pulsing light follows you down the corridor, fading slowly behind you like a living sunset. Some things are worth leaving whole.
